customer: Seriously, I got an offer on my convertible and now I'm hearing it might already be expired? I'm trying to trade up to something bigger here in Eastvale and I can't keep track of all these deadlines. How long do I actually have before this offer is dead?
agent: I understand the frustration, so let me lay it out clearly from our article "How long is my offer good for?": offers are valid for 5 days or 250 additional miles, whichever comes first, and offers issued before February 1, 2026 keep their original terms of 7 days or 300 miles. Your exact expiration date is shown on your offer page and in your confirmation email, and we honor the offer as long as your appraisal appointment is on or before that date. If it does expire, you can request a new offer at any time, though the new amount reflects current market prices and may be higher or lower. Just keep in mind that rescheduling your appointment doesn't extend the offer.
